questions.q1: How do I find available rooms?
questions.a1: Enter your destination, check-in/check-out dates, guest count and number of rooms on the home or search page. Results only show active properties and room types matching your criteria.
questions.q2: Where can I view my bookings?
questions.a2: After signing in, open the account menu and select "My Trips & Bookings". This page shows your booking code, stay schedule, payment status and processing status.
questions.a3: You can submit a cancellation on your personal bookings page when the booking status allows it. The final outcome depends on the current status confirmed by the backend.
questions.q4: What payment methods does NestBooking support?
questions.a4: The current flow supports pay at the property and VNPay Sandbox. If you choose VNPay, the result is only recorded after the backend verifies the response from the payment gateway.
questions.q5: Why hasn't my VNPay payment been recorded?
questions.a5: Check the payment result page or your personal bookings. A transaction only moves to paid status when the signature, amount and transaction status are successfully verified by the backend.
questions.q6: When do I need to sign in?
questions.a6: You can search and view properties without signing in. An account is required when proceeding to checkout and creating a booking.
questions.q7: How do I register as a partner?
questions.a7: Select "Register your property" in the Header, complete the partner account and wait for admin approval before using the full property management channel.
